edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the untrusted caller into the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before taking ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the untrusted caller as account key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the caller as owner key.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender key.
approveAndCall stores allowance for the caller and then forwards the caller into an external call.
safeAdd body executes the addition operation.
safeSub body executes the subtraction operation.
safeMul body executes the multiplication operation.
safeDiv body executes the division operation.
totalSupply performs a raw unchecked subtraction on supply and zero-address balance.
transfer updates balances through SafeMath arithmetic operations.
transferFrom updates balances and allowance through SafeMath arithmetic operations.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract after mutating allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an arbitrary external contract call from the privileged owner path.
